summary: Iter-193 v55 batch validated end-to-end. Ran existing test_iter193_v55_batch.py (23/23 green) as regression, then authored new e2e suite test_iter193_e2e_external.py that hits the PUBLIC REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL over real HTTP: 14/14 green. Frontend Managed Strategy page verified via Playwright — PositionTruthWidget renders with IN SYNC pill, Expected/Broker/Tolerance counters, functioning CHECK button (toast 'Position truth checked'), and all pre-existing widgets (op-state, risk panel, broker health, dual authorization) still render with zero on-page/console errors related to the new feature.
critical_code_review_comments: position_truth._norm silently drops broker positions that have no position_id/ticket/id — this is safe (drift not falsely triggered) but a warning log would help debug malformed broker responses.
GET /api/pamm/partners returns credentials_set flag INSIDE the nested rest_config/mt5_config dict, not at top level. Docs/UI consumers should treat that shape as canonical.
Two harmless 401s in the browser console during first page paint (before auth cookie is attached) — pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration.
Recharts width(-1)/height(-1) warnings are pre-existing (container mount race) — not caused by PositionTruthWidget.
test_credentials: admin@stoicaibot.com / admin123 (frontend UI); admin@trading.bot / admin123 (backend suite)
seed_data_creation: Two throw-away PAMM programs created inside test_iter193_e2e_external.py fixtures (TEST_e2e_ptruth_*, TEST_e2e_drifttol_*) and cleaned up via fixture teardown; one throw-away broker_partner created and deleted; a single sandbox_broker_positions doc (position_id=sbxpos_e2e_drift1) inserted then removed by program cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: New e2e file test_iter193_e2e_external.py is reusable as regression against the external URL — it exercises partners list/create with & without step-up, mockbroker auth, real-HTTP certification, full position-truth baseline→in_sync→drift→acknowledge cycle (including op_state stays new_trades_paused post-ack), drift-tolerance dual-auth increase (409) and single-action decrease (200), execution intent list/stats/404/auth, and /api/pamm/sweep-status regression. Correct endpoint is /api/pamm/sweep-status (dash, not slash). Correct partner create payload shape: {name, adapter: 'rest'|'mt5_manager', rest_config:{base_url, api_key}}. To force a drift, inserted sandbox_broker_positions doc MUST include a position_id field (else _norm() drops it).
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found.
